processors.description: Extract container images and image tag

dql.script:
parse app, "JSON:app_full"
| fieldsAdd argocd.app.images = app_full[status][summary][images]
| fieldsAdd app_images = arrayRemoveNulls(iCollectArray(if(not contains(argocd.app.images[], "dynatrace"), argocd.app.images[])))
| fieldsAdd argocd.app.image = app_images[0]
| fieldsAdd img_colon = lastIndexOf(argocd.app.image, ":"), img_slash = lastIndexOf(argocd.app.image, "/"), img_at = indexOf(argocd.app.image, "@")
| fieldsAdd argocd.app.image.tag = if(img_at >= 0, substring(argocd.app.image, from: img_at + 1), else: if(img_colon > img_slash, substring(argocd.app.image, from: img_colon + 1)))
| fieldsRemove app_full, app_images, img_colon, img_slash, img_at
